About

I'm a creative technologist in Montreal. I make AI video for advertising, and I build the tools that keep it on brand.

My work runs the whole way from concept to generated shots, image-to-video, client revisions and the finished spot. Alongside it I write custom ComfyUI nodes in Python that fix what makes AI footage unusable in a real job: characters that drift between shots, environments that change, logos that come out garbled.

I trained in VFX (FX TD diploma, Campus VFX, Montreal, 2023–2024), which is where the pipeline thinking comes from. Before that I spent seven years at Emirates as cabin crew, ending in Business Class: premium client service, and staying calm under pressure, every day. Most recently I worked in IT operations at oXya (2024–2026).

Since June 2025 I've been freelancing for production teams in Saudi Arabia, delivering AI imagery and video inside productions that also use CGI and VFX.

Open to roles as AI video creator, generative AI artist or creative technologist.
